implemented: Wired the canonical classify_node discriminator into the production structure/extract/interface paths for Elixir so EntityKind is populated additively: defmacro/defmacrop -> kind="macro", def/defp -> kind="method" inside a defmodule (else "function"), defmodule -> kind="module". Closes the #57 bidirectional seam (structure.definitions AND interface.functions now both report kind="macro" for the same defmacro nodes).
edits: extractor.rs::try_elixir_call_definition — compute DefinitionInfo.kind via crate::ast::entity::classify_node (single source of truth): EntityKind::Macro -> "macro"; otherwise preserve the existing module-context rule ("method" inside defmodule, "function" at top level). Replaces the previous hardcoded method/function-only branch that mislabelled macros as "method".

extractor.rs (FileStructure builder) — method_infos filter widened from `kind=="method"` to `kind=="method" || kind=="macro"` so Elixir macros (now kind="macro") are NOT dropped from the per-module method_infos view they have always appeared in. Elixir is the only producer of kind="macro" in definitions, so other languages stay byte-identical.
extract.rs::extract_elixir_module_info — ClassInfo.kind set from classify_node(defmodule call) -> "module" (was None), mirroring the Scala arm.
patterns/types.rs — added additive `kind: Option<String>` (serde default + skip_serializing_if=Option::is_none) to the interface FunctionInfo display struct.

patterns/interface.rs::extract_function_info — populate FunctionInfo.kind via classify_node, gated on Language::Elixir (macro/function); all other FunctionInfo construction sites set kind:None (JSON byte-identical for non-Elixir).
char_tests: tldr-core ast::extractor::tests::test_elixir_definition_kinds_macro_method_module — structure definitions: defmacro/defmacrop=macro, def/defp inside module=method, defmodule=module
tldr-core ast::extractor::tests::test_elixir_macros_retained_in_method_infos — macros remain in method_infos after the kind flip (no dropped construct)

json_delta: Elixir only. (1) `tldr structure` `definitions[].kind`: defmacro/defmacrop entries change "method"->"macro" (top-level macros "function"->"macro"); def/defp and defmodule unchanged. method_infos still contains the macros (filter now includes kind="macro"); method_infos schema itself unchanged (no kind field).
